principles.summary: Model expected error conditions as return values (a Result/discriminated union), not thrown exceptions. Reserve throw for truly unexpected, unrecoverable states.
principles.bad_example: function validate(x) { if (!ok) throw new Error('bad'); return x; }
principles.good_example: function validate(x): Result<T, E> { if (!ok) return { ok: false, error: 'bad' }; return { ok: true, data: x }; }
